core_obligations: Colimits and their exactness (proof lines 6042-6052): by the closure lemma colimits in quasi-coherent sheaves exist and agree with those in all modules, and filtered colimits are exact there, so the first two of the three Grothendieck conditions hold.

Construct a generator (proof lines 6054-6068): choose a presentation of X by an etale groupoid scheme with flat source and target maps, take the cardinal provided by the groupoid lemma and a set of generators of the category of compatible systems, and let F_t be the corresponding quasi-coherent sheaves on X; every quasi-coherent sheaf is the directed colimit of its quasi-coherent submodules isomorphic to some F_t, so the direct sum of the F_t is a generator; the assertions on limits and injectives then follow from the Grothendieck formalism.

Construct the right adjoint (proof lines 6070-6100): for an arbitrary module F consider the contravariant functor from quasi-coherent sheaves to sets given by Hom into F; it carries colimits to limits and hence is representable by Brown representability, giving a quasi-coherent sheaf Q(F) with a functorial identification of Hom sets; the Yoneda lemma makes F maps to Q(F) functorial, so Q is right adjoint to the inclusion, and the adjunction map is an isomorphism on quasi-coherent sheaves because the inclusion is fully faithful.
proof_roadmap: Establish the existence and exactness of colimits from the closure lemma and the general theory of sheaves of modules.
Build a generator from a presentation by an etale groupoid scheme and the boundedness of kappa-generated submodules.
Construct the coherator by representing a Hom functor and read off the adjunction properties.
difficulty_reason: The proposition proves that the category of quasi-coherent sheaves on an algebraic space is a Grothendieck abelian category, hence has enough injectives and all limits, and that the inclusion into all modules has a right adjoint whose adjunction map is an isomorphism on quasi-coherent sheaves (statement lines 6023-6040). The proof (proof lines 6042-6105) verifies the Grothendieck conditions using the closure lemma, constructs a generator from a presentation by an etale groupoid scheme with the boundedness results for compatible systems, and builds the right adjoint by Brown representability of a Hom functor. H3: three independent constructions with several inputs, written out in full.
